scope: In-place scheduler changes for the three pending jobs only; historical driver policies remain immutable
memory_basis: Measured largest per-rank MaxRSS 7025940 KiB; 32 times this is approximately 214.4 GiB per node, below 240 GiB. This is an observed bound, not a guarantee for future SCF steps.
binary: Same CPU vasp_std compiled with portable SSE4.2; no GPU port
notes: Job IDs and submission/eligible times preserved. Guards read the actual Slurm EndTime. Scheduler settings override old resource fields in immutable driver policies/status files. Tesla/all projected later; debug too short; nompi shares hardware and was not used to bypass MPI partition conventions. v100 has 24 physical CPU cores / 48 hardware threads, so earlier launch is established by forecast, not improved SCF throughput.
